scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "Frontend,Admin,Backend" -c "orange,purple,cyan" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin && npm run build:backend
